name: Free text format code
description: Code specifying the format of free text.

values.name: Centre
values.description: Centre The associated text is centred in the available space.

values.name: Left
values.description: Left The associated text item is aligned flush left in the available space.

values.name: Right
values.description: Right The associated text is aligned flush right in the available space.

values.name: Justified
values.description: Justified The associated text is justified in the available space.

values.name: Preceded by one blank line
values.description: Preceded by one blank line The text is to be preceded by one blank line.

values.name: Preceded by two blank lines
values.description: Preceded by two blank lines The text is to be preceded by two blank lines.

values.name: Preceded by three blank lines
values.description: Preceded by three blank lines The text is to be preceded by three blank lines.

values.name: Continuation
values.description: Continuation The text is a continuation of preceding text.

values.name: New page
values.description: New page The text is to begin on a new page.

values.name: End text
values.description: End text The text is the final section of the preceding text.

values.name: New line
values.description: New line The text is to begin a new line.
